signature.scope: Exploratory direct-surrogate check after the residual-confidence outcomes were inspected. Reuse the known-only nuisance decoder, construct a hidden proxy using only four tasks numeric output/confidence features and length, and fit generator maps on calibration proxies. No conditional-test target hidden vector or true label enters decoder or generator fitting/selection. Predictions start from the output-only proxy at the current input; original numeric-null target vectors are used only for scoring. All groups and trained/initialization cases are reported. Decoder training does use calibration hidden vectors, so this is a learned output surrogate, not a representation constructed without any hidden-vector access. Word rules and generator fitting are supplied by the framework.
